question: Who first introduced Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and in what year?
ground_truth: Lewis et al. first introduced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in 2020.

question: What are the three core phases of a standard RAG pipeline?
ground_truth: The three core phases of a standard RAG pipeline are Ingestion, Retrieval, and Generation.

question: What algorithm is used to combine dense and sparse search results in hybrid retrieval?
ground_truth: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) is used to combine dense and sparse search results.

question: Why does RAG cost less than fine-tuning or training a model?
ground_truth: RAG is more cost-efficient because updating the system's knowledge base only requires re-indexing text documents, which is a fraction of the cost of training or fine-tuning models.

question: What are the standard working hours at Acme Corp?
ground_truth: Standard working hours at Acme Corp are from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

question: How many days of Paid Time Off (PTO) do full-time employees receive annually at Acme Corp?
ground_truth: Full-time employees receive 20 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per calendar year, accrued monthly at a rate of 1.67 days per month.
source_section: 3. Annual Leave and Paid Time Off (PTO)

question: How many unused PTO days can be carried over to the next calendar year at Acme Corp?
ground_truth: Unused PTO up to a maximum of 5 days may be carried over into the next calendar year. Any additional unused PTO exceeding 5 days is forfeited on December 31st.
source_section: 3. Annual Leave and Paid Time Off (PTO)

question: What is Acme Corp's policy on harassment and discrimination?
ground_truth: Acme Corp has zero tolerance for harassment, discrimination, or bullying of any kind, and is committed to maintaining a safe, inclusive, and professional workspace.

question: Which architecture is the foundation for modern Large Language Models, and when was it introduced?
ground_truth: Modern Large Language Models are built on the Transformer architecture introduced by Vaswani et al. in 2017.

question: What context window size is supported by Llama 3.1?
ground_truth: Llama 3.1 supports a context window of 128k tokens.
source_section: 2. Llama 3.1: The Open-Weights State of the Art

question: How many tokens was Llama 3.1 trained on?
ground_truth: Llama 3.1 was trained on a dataset of over 15 trillion tokens.
source_section: 2. Llama 3.1: The Open-Weights State of the Art

question: Why does the Groq LPU use SRAM directly on the chip instead of standard memory?
ground_truth: The Groq LPU utilizes Static Random-Access Memory (SRAM) laid out directly on the chip. This bypasses the memory-bandwidth bottlenecks of traditional GPUs, enabling deterministic execution and high throughputs (exceeding 500 tokens per second).
source_section: 3. Groq LPU: Overcoming the Memory Wall
